title: Potential PrintNightmare Exploitation Attempt
rules_yaml:
title: Potential PrintNightmare (CVE-2021-1675) Exploitation
id: 5d0a75f1-e0c0-46a0-9e01-7a559e3c5c88
status: experimental
description: Detects potential exploitation of CVE-2021-1675 (PrintNightmare) via suspicious process creation or DLL loading related to spoolsv.exe
author: Sigma Team
date: 2026/09/11
references:
  - https://github.com/cube0x0/CVE-2021-1675
  - https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2021-1675
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection1:
    Image|endswith: \spoolsv.exe
    CommandLine|contains:
      - rundll32.exe
      - msiexec.exe
      - powershell.exe
  selection2:
    ParentImage|endswith: \spoolsv.exe
    Image|endswith:
      - \cmd.exe
      - \powershell.exe
      - \wscript.exe
      - \cscript.exe
      - \rundll32.exe
  condition: 1 of selection*
fields:
  - User
  - Image
  - ParentImage
  - CommandLine
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1203
  - attack.privilege-escalation
  - attack.t1068
  - cve.cve-2021-1675
level: high

title: Citrix ADS Exploitation CVE-2020-8193 CVE-2020-8195
rules_yaml:
title: Citrix ADC Command Injection via Unauthenticated HTTP POST
id: 5f8b3a4c-1e2d-4f5a-9b6c-7d8e9f0a1b2c
status: experimental
description: Detects unauthenticated command injection attempts in Citrix ADC appliances via HTTP POST to /citrix/adc/portal/scripts/owa/owa.js with crafted JSON payload containing command injection patterns.
references:
    - https://support.citrix.com/article/CTX276688
    - https://research.nccgroup.com/2020/07/10/rift-citrix-adc-vulnerabilities-cve-2020-8193-cve-2020-8195-and-cve-2020-8196-intelligence/
    - https://dmaasland.github.io/posts/citrix.html
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1190/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1203/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-11
tags:
    - attack.initial_access
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1190
    - attack.t1203
logsource:
    category: webserver
    product: apache
    service: httpd
detection:
    selection:
        cs-method: POST
        cs-uri-stem: /citrix/adc/portal/scripts/owa/owa.js
        cs-uri-query|contains: 'json='
        cs-uri-query|contains: '"cmd":".*\$\(`
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative tools using the same endpoint with valid JSON payloads
    - Automated monitoring scripts that may use similar command patterns
level: high
